Home/IoT Sensors/Intelligent SPD monitoring terminal

Monitor SPD condition.
Plan maintenance.

HiSPD-DPU-04 is an intelligent monitoring terminal for surge protective devices (SPDs). Four simultaneous monitoring channels provide condition information to help electrical maintenance teams identify SPDs requiring inspection or replacement. Applications include selected protection points in building electrical services, wind-energy auxiliaries and field equipment. The series offers 2-, 4- and 8-channel configurations.

MONITORING & MAINTENANCE

Monitor SPD condition.
Focus the maintenance.

Four simultaneous channels provide SPD condition information for inspection and replacement decisions. Apply the terminal to selected protection points in building services and electrical equipment.

SPD condition monitoring

Monitor the operating condition of surge protective devices. Identify SPDs requiring attention so inspection and replacement can be based on the condition of the monitored protection equipment.

Four simultaneous channels

HiSPD-DPU-04 brings four SPD monitoring channels into one terminal. Monitor the selected protection points together within the agreed installation arrangement.

Maintenance and replacement indication

Use SPD condition information to determine which protection device needs inspection or replacement. Direct maintenance to the indicated device within the electrical installation.

2-, 4- and 8-channel variants

Select the series variant for the required number of monitoring channels. HiSPD-DPU-04 is the four-channel model shown on this page.

Building electrical services

Apply SPD monitoring at selected protection points in main distribution, local boards and rooftop-services cabinets. Include SPD condition in the building’s electrical maintenance programme.

Wind and field equipment

Extend the monitoring plan to selected SPDs in wind-energy auxiliary systems and field cabinets. Specify the protection devices and cabinet conditions for the installation.

SPD CONDITION & MAINTENANCE

SPD condition.
A clearer basis for maintenance.

An SPD limits transient overvoltages within an electrical installation. Protected equipment may continue operating even when its SPD requires maintenance. Monitoring the protective device provides a separate basis for assessing that service need. HiSPD-DPU-04 monitors four SPD channels simultaneously, helping the electrical maintenance team identify the protection point concerned and arrange inspection or replacement.

Find your application ↓
  1. 01

    Monitor SPD condition

    Obtain condition information from the SPDs included in the four-channel monitoring arrangement.

  2. 02

    Identify the protection point

    Use the channel assignment to identify the relevant SPD and the distribution board or equipment it serves.

  3. 03

    Inspect or replace

    Assess the indicated device and follow the SPD manufacturer’s inspection and replacement instructions.

FROM SPD CONDITION TO MAINTENANCE

From condition information.
To maintenance action.

Connect the monitoring indication to the assigned SPD, assess the service requirement and carry out the appropriate maintenance. A documented channel assignment makes the relevant protection point identifiable.

01

Monitor

Monitor four SPD channels simultaneously with HiSPD-DPU-04.

02

Identify

Relate the indicated channel to the assigned SPD and protection point.

03

Inspect

Review the condition indication and assess the device under the applicable service procedure.

04

Maintain

Replace the SPD where indicated and verify completion of the maintenance work.

HiSPD-DPU-04 · ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCEThe indicated SPD.
The required maintenance.

Assess condition indications using the SPD manufacturer’s service instructions and the installation’s electrical maintenance procedure. Inspection and replacement are performed by the responsible maintenance team.

SPD MONITORING: TECHNICAL QUESTIONS

Frequently
asked questions.

Direct answers about SPD condition monitoring, four-channel operation, compatibility, installation and maintenance.

Ask about your project ↗
What is the HiSPD-DPU-04 intelligent SPD monitoring terminal?+

HiSPD-DPU-04 is an intelligent terminal for monitoring the operating condition of surge protective devices (SPDs). It monitors four channels simultaneously and provides condition information to support inspection and replacement decisions.

The series includes 2-, 4- and 8-channel configurations. HiSPD-DPU-04 identifies the four-channel model.

Understand SPD monitoring →
What is a surge protective device (SPD)?+

A surge protective device limits transient overvoltages in an electrical installation. SPDs are used at defined protection points in electrical distribution and equipment interfaces.

The SPD performs the protective function. The monitoring terminal provides information about the condition of the selected protective devices.

Review the monitoring role →
What is the purpose of SPD condition monitoring?+

SPD condition monitoring helps electrical maintenance teams identify protective devices requiring inspection or replacement. It adds information about the protective device itself to the maintenance decision.

HiSPD-DPU-04 provides this information through four simultaneous monitoring channels. Each channel must have a defined assignment within the selected SPD monitoring arrangement.

See the maintenance workflow →
Why monitor an SPD when the protected equipment is still running?+

Equipment operation alone does not establish the condition of its surge protection. An SPD can require maintenance while the associated equipment continues operating.

Monitoring the SPD gives the maintenance team a separate basis for reviewing the protective device and arranging inspection or replacement where indicated.

Connect monitoring to maintenance →
Can HiSPD-DPU-04 be used with existing SPDs?+

An existing installation can be assessed for a supported SPD monitoring arrangement. Compatibility depends on the SPD model, its monitoring connection and the terminal configuration.

Provide the SPD manufacturer and model, connection details and cabinet drawing. Confirm compatibility against the selected terminal’s technical documentation before installation.

Discuss an existing installation →
Does DPU-04 mean four monitoring channels?+

Yes. HiSPD-DPU-04 monitors four SPD channels simultaneously. The series also offers 2- and 8-channel versions.

A monitoring channel is not a phase or pole count. Its relationship to SPD modules or protection modes is defined by the documented connection arrangement.

Review the channel options →
Does SPD condition monitoring measure lightning or surge current?+

SPD condition monitoring and surge-current measurement address different information needs. The former concerns the protective device’s condition; the latter measures an electrical event using a specified sensing arrangement.

If event measurement is required, specify it separately and confirm the supporting equipment and configuration. It should not be inferred from the SPD monitoring product category.

Describe your monitoring requirements →
How does SPD condition information support maintenance planning?+

Condition information helps identify which monitored SPD needs assessment and defines the protection point involved. The maintenance team can use that information to determine the required inspection or replacement work.

The service decision follows the SPD manufacturer’s instructions and the site’s maintenance procedure. Monitoring information supports that decision; it does not perform the maintenance.

Explore the monitoring locations →
How are monitoring channels linked to the installed SPDs?+

The installation design assigns each monitoring channel to a specified SPD monitoring point. Record that assignment with the board, cabinet and equipment references in the electrical drawing.

Use the same identifiers in the receiving system where applicable. This allows the team to relate an indication to the intended protection device.

Review the monitoring arrangement →
What should be checked before installing the terminal?+

Check the selected SPD monitoring connection, terminal supply requirements, mounting arrangement, wiring access and cabinet environment against the documentation for the supplied version.

For rooftop and outdoor equipment, include the enclosure conditions in the review. Obtain the matching electrical and installation information before finalizing the design.

Share the installation details →
How should integration with a building or maintenance system be specified?+

Define the SPD condition information the receiving system needs, together with the channel and equipment identifiers used by the maintenance team.

Match those requirements to the supported interface, communication specification and information format of the supplied terminal version. Confirm the configuration before implementing the integration.

Review integration requirements →
When should a monitored SPD be inspected or replaced?+

Review an indicated maintenance need against the SPD manufacturer’s service instructions and the site’s electrical maintenance procedure. The responsible team determines whether inspection, replacement or another specified service action is required.

Use the channel assignment to identify the correct device and verify completion of the required work.

Follow the service workflow →
Which building protection points are candidates for SPD monitoring?+

Typical candidate locations include main distribution boards, floor and tenant boards, rooftop-services cabinets and compatible IT or security protection interfaces.

Select the monitored points around the installed SPD models and supported connections. The required monitoring-channel count determines the appropriate series configuration.

Explore building applications →
Which wind-energy protection points are candidates for SPD monitoring?+

Candidate points include SPDs in turbine tower-base cabinets, nacelle auxiliary systems, transformer-station low-voltage auxiliaries and measurement or SCADA field cabinets.

Confirm the SPD connection and terminal installation requirements for each selected point. The monitoring task concerns the SPD, rather than wind measurement or diagnosis of the protected equipment.

Explore wind-energy applications →
Does SPD condition monitoring replace inspection and servicing?+

SPD condition monitoring supports inspection and replacement decisions. The SPD manufacturer’s instructions and the site’s maintenance procedure still define the required service work.

Use the monitoring indication to direct attention to the relevant device, assess its service requirement and verify that the required maintenance has been completed.
